subject: Digital Signal Processing (DSP) & Linear Systems
topic: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and Nyquist-Shannon Sampling Theorem
syllabus_context: Unit II: Discrete-Time Signals and Frequency Analysis. Sampling of continuous-time signals, frequency spectrum, Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) definition, synthesis and analysis equations, DFT frequency bin spacing Delta f = f_s / N, Nyquist sampling rate and criterion f_s > 2 f_max, spectral aliasing foldover, and anti-aliasing filtering.
declared_learning_objective: Formulate the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) analysis equation, calculate frequency bin indices and spectral resolution for discrete sampling windows, prove the Nyquist-Shannon sampling criterion to prevent spectral aliasing, and evaluate anti-aliasing filter roll-off and finite-record spectral leakage.

provenance.source: Standard Academic Digital Signal Processing Lecture Series

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Complex exponential twiddle factors and frequency spectrum foldover diagrams drawn on chalkboard.
